content.comment_body: How can I install a root certificate on my iPhone? The instructions in the manual and online resources are unclear—there is just one image and the text says to click to install. Is it even necessary to install this certificate to run my [product_name] project on an iPhone? Everything works fine in Google Chrome on my PC, but not on the iPhone. Thank you.

I already have the manual and noticed there was only a single snippet about installation—how do I get to that step? The other options are covered in more detail. [IMAGE] Can anyone offer some guidance on how to reach step 1? Thanks.

Here’s what I’ve tried so far; any feedback is appreciated, even if someone could confirm I’m heading in the right direction. I sent myself two files via email. [IMAGE] After opening the email on my iPhone and tapping the attachments, they showed up in the settings menu where I was able to install the certificate. There was just one item, so I went back and repeated the process for the [product_name]RootCert.pem, though I believe it worked the first time. However, I still cannot access my PLC from the Safari browser on the iPhone. The HTTPS login works on my laptop using Google Chrome, so at least that part is correct. My main motivation for using this PLC was the claim that it's compatible and straightforward. In reality, I can’t get my iPhone to log into the web server on the PLC as shown in official documentation and online tutorials. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having difficulty installing a root certificate on an iPhone to access the web server of a [company_name] PLC. Documentation provides limited and unclear guidance, with fewer step-by-step details than for other platforms. While the process works smoothly on a PC, the user encounters obstacles on iOS and finds the expected ease of use and compatibility from official literature does not match real-world experience.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks comprehensive, step-by-step instructions for certificate installation on iPhone. They expect a straightforward and platform-independent experience, with web server access on iPhone being as simple as on a PC, as advertised by [company_name].
